content.en: Have you played tug of war? Two teams hold a big rope. There is a line between the teams. Both teams pull and pull! The team that pulls the other team across the line wins!
content.tw: 拔河是有趣的比賽，兩支隊伍握著繩子兩端，用力向後拉，把對方拉過中線就獲勝。

content.en: Every year, there is a big tug-of-war contest. This year, it was in South Africa. Teams came from many countries. Many teams came from Taiwan.
content.tw: 今年的大型拔河比賽在南非舉辦。參賽隊伍來自世界各地，包括台灣。

content.en: Taiwan's senior women's team played against Germany's team. It was the big final match. The winner had to win two out of three pulls.
content.tw: 女子組的決賽由台灣對上德國，三戰兩勝的隊伍就是贏家。

content.en: At first, the ground was hard. Pulling was easy. But then the ground got soft. The teams tried not to fall! Pulling got much harder.
content.tw: 一開始，地面硬度夠很好施力，但之後土地變得鬆軟，增加了拔河的難度。

content.en: Taiwan's team almost lost the first pull. But the German team made three mistakes. That let Taiwan win the pull. The team was excited. It pulled harder for the second pull. It won the pull! And it won the match!
content.tw: 台灣隊差點輸掉第一局，但因為德國隊出現三次犯規，台灣隊還是贏了。士氣大振之下，台灣隊第二局更加賣力，最終贏得這場決賽。

content.en: Taiwan's senior women's team won a gold medal. It was the team's fifth gold medal in five years! Other teams from Taiwan won medals too. Taiwan and South Africa had the most medals!
content.tw: 台灣女子隊奪得金牌，也是這支隊伍的第五面金牌！其他台灣隊伍也有得牌，台灣和南非成為贏得最多獎牌的國家！

content.en: Keep pulling hard, Taiwan!
content.tw: 台灣加油，繼續努力拔河吧！

vocabulary.preface: 台灣的拔河代表隊，經常在國際大賽中勝出。

content.text:
1. winner 贏家。
Did you watch yesterday’s badminton match? 你有沒有看昨天的羽球賽?
Yes! What a match! 有，好精采!
I thought the winner was going to lose! 我以為那個贏家會輸掉!

2. mistake 錯誤。
Me too! 我也是。
But the American player made more mistakes.不過那個美國球員犯的錯更多。
Right, mistakes are often key. 對，犯錯經常是關鍵。

3. hard 用力地。
Sometimes it’s better to play it safe, not play it hard. 有時候打安全球比用力打要好。
Hey, you’re becoming very smart! 你變得很聰明了!

4. many 很多的。
I’ve learned something after losing many games. 我輸了很多比賽之後終於學到了一點。
Good for you! 很好!

vocabulary.postscript:
來一起讀單字。
winner贏家 mistake錯誤 hard用力地 many很多的

quiz.question: 1. What does a team need to pull the other team across to win?
2. What team did Taiwan's senior women's team play against in the final match?
3. What happened to the ground during the first pull?

content.en: Last year, big typhoons came to Hualien. The heavy rain caused landslides. Rocks and dirt fell down the mountains. The landslides took away many trees and other plants. This is bad for the mountains. Trees and plants help hold dirt. They keep the mountains strong.
content.tw: 去年，一場很大颱風在花蓮造成土石流，帶走很多樹木和植物。山坡上的樹木和植物對水土保持很重要，要怎麼辦呢?

content.en: Taiwan wanted to help the mountains. It wanted to plant new trees and plants. But the mountains are very high. Going there is very dangerous. So… nobody went. What? Drones, not people, went! Drones are small flying robots.
content.tw: 想重新修復山坡，但工人在高山上工作太危險了， 台灣於是出動了現代高科技產物 - 無人機幫忙。你覺得會成功嗎？

content.en: They can fly up the mountains. The drones carried tree and plant seeds. The seeds were wrapped with things to help them grow. They were also wrapped to keep them safe. Then away they went! The drones flew high up the mountains. Then they dropped the seeds! The drones did this many times. They planted a lot of seeds.
content.tw: 無人機帶著包好的樹木和植物的種子來回很多趟，飛往山坡上方，投下種子。

content.en: After a while, the drones went back to the mountains. Some small plants were growing!
content.tw: 期待有一天，大樹和植物長大，花蓮的山恢復強壯。

content.en: One day, they will grow into big trees and other plants. And the mountains in Hualien will be strong again!
content.tw: 總有一天，它們會長成大樹和其他植物。花蓮的山也會再次變得強壯！

vocabulary.preface: 無人機在花蓮受山崩破壞的山坡上播種，幫助植物重新生長。

content.text:
1. small 小的。
I only need a small bag. 我只需要一個小袋子。
Really? You have milk, eggs, apples… 你買了牛奶、蛋、蘋果…Oh, and a watermelon! 還有一顆西瓜！

2. carry 提。
Can you carry this for me? 你可以幫我提這個嗎？
The watermelon? Okay. 西瓜嗎？好。
Thanks! I'll take the eggs. 謝啦！我來拿蛋。

3. strong 強壯的。
Wait. Why do I get the watermelon? 等等，為什麼是我拿西瓜？
You're strong! 你力氣大啊！
It's still heavy! 可是這顆還是很重耶！

4. again 再一次。
Next time, let's bring your shopping cart. 下次我們帶你的買菜車吧。
Good idea. I'm not carrying this again! 好主意，我不要再提西瓜了！

vocabulary.postscript: 來複習今天的單字。 small 小的、carry 提、搬、strong 強壯的、again 再一次。

quiz.question: 1. How do trees and plants help mountains?
2. What carried the seeds up to the mountains?
3. Why were the seeds wrapped?

content.en: What happens when it rains? Cars turn on their windshield wipers. Motorcycle riders put on raincoats. People open their umbrellas. Everyone tries to stay dry. But In Taipei, four junior high school kids got wet.
content.tw: 下雨天的時候，大家都不想淋雨，但在台北，卻有四名國中生在淋雨。發生了甚麼事呢？

content.en: Why? These kids saw an older man. He was pushing a big cart. Many cardboard boxes were on the cart. The rain made them very wet. Pushing the cart was getting hard for the man. The cardboard boxes were a lot heavier from the rain. Some of them fell off the cart.
content.tw: 這些學生們看到路上有一位老人，很辛苦地推著一輛上面堆滿濕漉漉的紙箱的推車。

content.en: The four kids ran to the man. They wanted to help! They thought the man could finish early with help. Then he could rest! Two kids held umbrellas. Two kids pushed the cart. That is good teamwork! The rain kept falling. One kid had to go. But the other three kept helping! They helped the man go to an elementary school.
content.tw: 老人家在雨中推著堆滿紙箱的推車，應該很辛苦吧。四位學生趕快跑過去幫忙，他們又是撐傘又是推車 ，終於推到國小。如果是你看到了需要幫忙的人，你也會這麼做嗎？

content.en: Helping is kind. Being kind can be easy. You can ask "Can I help?" Look around. Can you help someone in some way? You can be kind, too!
content.tw: 助人為快樂之本。行善可以很簡單。你可以問「需要幫忙嗎？」看看四周，你也能以某種方式伸出援手。你也可以是個善良的人！

vocabulary.preface: 台北四名國中生冒雨幫老人家推車，想讓他早點回家休息。

content.text:
1. rain 雨。
Listen to that rain! 聽聽那個雨聲！And we have to go out for lunch. 我們還得出去吃午餐。
Do we? I have some cookies. 要嗎，我有餅乾耶。

2. umbrella 雨傘。
Cookies aren't lunch! 餅乾不能當午餐啦！
I have an umbrella. We can share. 我有傘，可以一起撐。

3. wet 濕的。
That little umbrella? We'll get wet! 那把小傘？我們會淋到雨啦！
Only a little. 只會濕一點點。
You said that last time! 你上次也這樣說！

4. dry 乾的。
Fine. Let's stay dry and eat here. 好啦，我們在這裡吃飯，就不會淋濕了。So... cookies? 所以，要吃餅乾嗎？
No. Let's order lunch! 不要，我們叫外送！

vocabulary.postscript: 下雨天也可以學新單字! rain 雨、umbrella 雨傘、wet 濕的、dry 乾的。

quiz.question: 1. How was the weather?
2. How many kids helped the man?
3. What did the man and the kids push?

title: Dogs Can Understand Feelings on Our Faces

content.en: Dogs can do many things. They can play with us. They can make us happy. They can find things with their noses. And they can hear very well. Scientists found something else dogs can do. Dogs can understand the feelings we show on our faces!
content.tw: 你有養狗狗嗎？你的狗狗會陪你玩嗎？科學家居然發現，狗狗通人性，能讀懂我們的心情好壞！

content.en: The scientists put the dogs in a big machine. The machine can look at the dogs' brains. The scientists showed pictures to the dogs. People in some pictures looked happy. People in other pictures looked angry, sad, or scared. The machine looked at the dogs’ brains when they saw each face. When the dogs saw a happy face, one part of their brain started to work more. This part makes dogs feel good.
content.tw: 科學家給狗狗看各種表情的照片，你覺得狗狗有辦法分辨出人類的情緒嗎？

content.en: When the dogs saw an angry, sad, or scared face, their brains worked in a different way. That means the dogs can see different feelings on people's faces. Dogs can understand our feelings in other ways too. They can look at our body language. They can listen to our voices. They can smell us!
content.tw: 結果發現，看到不同表情，狗狗的腦袋會有不同的反應。其實，科學家已經證實狗狗有很多方法知道主人的心情，也許在未來我們會發現更多！

content.en: We have a lot more to learn about what dogs can do!
content.tw: 關於狗狗的能力，我們還有很多需要學習了解的地方！

vocabulary.preface: 科學家發現，狗狗能分辨我們臉上的不同情緒！

content.text:
1. happy 開心、高興
Your dog looks happy to see me! 你的狗看到我好開心！
You brought his favorite toy. 你帶了牠最喜歡的玩具。

2. sad 難過
He was sad when you left yesterday. 你昨天離開時，牠很難過。
I can stay longer today. 我今天可以待久一點。

3. scared 害怕的
Oh! Is he scared of that noise? 喔！牠怕那個聲音嗎？
Yes. Let’s close the window. 對，我們把窗戶關起來吧。

4. face 臉
Look at his face. He wants to play! 看牠的臉，牠想玩了！
Okay! Go get your toy! 好！去拿你的玩具吧！

vocabulary.postscript: 今天的單字是：happy 開心、高興 sad 難過 scared 害怕的 face 臉

quiz.question: 1. What did the scientists study?
2. Where did the scientists put the dogs?
3. What happened when the dogs saw a happy face?
options: a. A part of their brains stopped working.
b. All parts of their brains worked more.
c. A part of their brains worked more.

content.en: Taipei had big parades on two nights. People came from all over Taiwan and the world. Musicians played music. Dancers danced on the street.
Three big elephants walked on the street with them! The elephants' heads slowly went up and down. Their big ears slowly moved. A rider sat on each elephant!
The elephants are not real. They are very big puppets! The parade had bird puppets too. People made these puppets move.
Artists from France made this parade 18 years ago. The elephant puppets walked in 30 cities in 8 countries! Each time, the artists made the parade about the city.

The parade in Taipei was about Taipei and the Taipei Zoo! Forty years ago, the zoo moved. It moved the animals in a big parade! Twenty buses carried big elephants, tall giraffes, and more. Many people came to watch. Maybe someone you know watched too!
And maybe some people watching the elephant puppets remembered Lin Wang. This elephant was in the zoo parade. Everyone loved him!
People loved the elephant and bird puppets from France too. They loved the music and the dancing. The second night was the 100th time the parade was done! People sang a birthday song!
The artists made a Taipei story with their elephant puppets. Taipei will remember these parades for a long, long time!
content.tw: 藝術家們用他們的大象木偶創造了一個台北故事。台北將會長久地記住這些遊行！

vocabulary.preface: 你有看到機械大象走上台北街頭嗎?

content.text:
1. night 晚上
It’s a nice night. Let’s go for a walk. 今晚天氣真好。我們去散步吧。
Sure. I want to buy some fruit, too. 好啊。我也想買點水果。

2. street 街道
There’s a fruit shop on this street. 這條街上有一家水果店。
Oh, look! 你看！Why are all those people here? 怎麼有那麼多人？

3. music 音樂
There’s a band! 有樂團耶！I love this music. 我喜歡這個音樂。
Me too. 我也是。And people are dancing! 而且還有人在跳舞！

4. watch 看；觀看
Let’s watch them for a few minutes. 我們看幾分鐘吧。
Okay. We can buy fruit later. 好啊。我們可以晚點再買水果。

vocabulary.postscript: 我們再念一次：night 晚上 street 街道 music 音樂 watch 看；觀看。

quiz.question: 1. What kind of puppets were in the parade?
2. How many cities did this parade go to?
3. What was the parade about?

content.en: In one part of Rwanda, many kids need healthy food. But eggs and vegetables cost a lot of money. One woman was very worried. Her young child was too thin. Rwanda has a food program. But it does not give food. It gives four chickens to families! It teaches families how to take care of them.
content.tw: 在非洲盧安達，許多孩童吃的東西營養都不夠。政府的計畫竟然是發給每個家庭四隻雞。蛤？為什麼？

content.en: This program helped her family! Soon they ate eggs every day. And the child grew little by little! But kids need different kinds of food so they can grow well. So the program teaches families how to grow food. Now some grow spinach, carrots, or sweet potatoes in their gardens. Some grow mushrooms.
content.tw: 孩子除了有雞蛋可以吃，為了讓營養更均衡，他們也要學習怎麼種東西，像是菠菜、胡蘿蔔、地瓜還有香菇。

content.en: Families share or sell food they do not need. They can get different kinds of food from each other. The program also teaches families how to cook healthy dishes. Each dish has different kinds of food in it.
content.tw: 盧安達的這項計畫很棒， 不僅讓家庭可以互相交換作物，也學習到如何煮出營養的料理，幫助孩子健康長大！

content.en: This program helps families give their kids healthy food. And the kids are growing well!
content.tw: 這項計畫幫助家庭提供孩子健康的食物，而孩子們也長得很健康！

vocabulary.preface: 盧安達計畫教每個家庭如何養雞，種菜。

content.text:
1. food 食物
What can we make for dinner? 我們晚餐可以做什麼？
Let’s see what food we have in the fridge. 我們看看冰箱裡有什麼食物吧。

2. egg 雞蛋
We have eggs. 我們有蛋。How about an egg sandwich? 吃雞蛋三明治怎麼樣？
Hmm...I want something hot. 我想吃熱的。Let’s make noodles! 我們煮麵吧。

3. vegetable 蔬菜
Let’s put some vegetables in, too. 我們也加一些蔬菜吧。
Here’s a carrot. 這裡有一根胡蘿蔔。Can you wash it? 你可以洗一下嗎？

4. cook 煮；烹調
Sure. Can you cook the noodles? 好啊。你可以煮麵嗎？I’ll cut the carrot. 我來切胡蘿蔔。
Okay. I’ll add an egg for each of us. 我幫我們各加一顆蛋。

vocabulary.postscript: Let’s review! Food 食物 egg 雞蛋 vegetable 蔬菜 cook 煮；烹調。

quiz.question: 1. Why was the woman worried?
options: a. She did not have mushrooms.
b. She had too many eggs.
c. Her child was too thin.

quiz.question: 2. What does Rwanda's program give many families?
3. What do kids need so they can grow well?

title: These Kind Heroes Put Out Fires Too

content.en: We call firefighters to put out fires and help with other emergencies. In Taiwan, we call 119!
content.tw: 我們打電話給消防員來滅火並協助處理其他緊急情況。在台灣，我們撥打 119！

content.en: In the U.S., a man was cutting the grass in front of his house. But he got very sick. Firefighters came and helped him. The man went to the hospital.
content.tw: 緊急狀況的時候，消防隊可以幫上大忙。一名美國男子正在院子裡除草，忽然覺得很不舒服，消防隊把他送進了醫院。

content.en: The firefighters were ready to leave the man's house. But then they looked at the grass. Half was not cut! It did not look nice. So the firefighters helped! They cut the rest of the grass! The firefighters put a video online. It showed them cutting the grass. Many people saw it. Some shared stories about other kind firefighters!
content.tw: 但是沒有除完的雜草很難看，消防隊員於是完成了這個工作。影片傳上網之後，很多人也分享消防隊員如何提供協助。

content.en: One time, a man was clearing snow. But he got sick. Firefighters came and helped him. Then they cleared the rest of the snow! Another time, a woman was cooking. But she got burned. Firefighters came and helped her. Then they did the rest of the cooking!
content.tw: 清掃雪堆的男子突然病倒，女子飯煮了一半被燙傷，都是消防隊員幫忙做完事情。他們是熱心助人的英雄!

content.en: Firefighters help in emergencies. And sometimes they help in other ways. They are kind heroes!
content.tw: 消防員在緊急情況下提供協助。有時他們也會以其他方式幫忙。他們是仁慈的英雄！

vocabulary.preface: 這些消防人員不但能救火，還會做很多其他的事。

content.text:
1. call 打電話。
If you see smoke coming from your kitchen, 假如你看到廚房冒煙，
what would you do? 你會怎麼辦?
I’d call the fire department right away. 馬上打電話給消防隊。

2. fire 火。
And what would you tell them? 你會怎麼說?
“Help! My dinner is on fire!” 救命啊，我的晚飯燒起來了!

3. firefighter 救火員。
What? You should say your kitchen is on fire! 什麼? 你應該說廚房起火了!
You don’t expect the firefighters to bring you dinner, do you? 你不會期待救火員幫你帶晚餐來吧?

4. story 故事。
Why not? They’re coming anyway. 為什麼不行? 他們反正就要來了。
You’d make a good news story, you know. 你會成為很好的新聞。

vocabulary.postscript:
這些單字很有用喔。
call打電話 fire火 firefighter救火員 story故事

quiz.question: 1. What happened when the man cut his grass?
options: b. The man got very sick.

quiz.question: 2. Why didn’t the grass look nice?
options: c. All of it was cut.

quiz.question: 3. What did the video show the firefighters doing?

content.en: After high school, students may go to university. Many students move into dorms at their university. Dorms are buildings with many bedrooms. One university in Kaohsiung had twenty to thirty visitors. They tried to move into a dorm. But they did not tell the university. And they were not students!
content.tw: 高雄有一所大學的學生宿舍來了二三十位訪客。牠們是誰呢？

content.en: They were monkeys! They lived nearby on a mountain. One found an open window in the dorm. It went back to the mountain. Then it came back to the dorm. It came with many friends! The monkeys ran into the dorm. They found snacks. They ate them! They found drinks. They drank them! And they made big messes everywhere!
content.tw: 原來是猴子！呼朋引伴的猴子們跑進宿舍房間裡搜括所有的食物飲料，把宿舍弄得一團亂！

content.en: Then... whoops! One monkey inside dropped food outside. It fell onto the ground. All the monkeys raced to it! They started sliding and climbing down the front of the dorm! One student said these monkeys were scary. One said they were cool. Some put videos of them online.
content.tw: 這些小賊還把食物丟到窗外，猴群跟著往下衝。學生對這些猴子的反應不一，有人覺得很恐怖，有人覺得很酷。如果是你碰到這群猴子，會不會害怕？

content.en: What do you think? Are many monkeys climbing down a building scary?
content.tw: 你覺得呢？許多猴子從建築物爬下來很可怕嗎？

vocabulary.preface: 大群猴子跑進了宿舍，讓學生有點不知所措。

content.text:
1. run 跑。
I can’t imagine walking into my room and finding a monkey there!
我不能想像走進房間，裡面有隻猴子!
Me neither. I’d run away as fast as I could. 我也不能，我會儘快逃走。

2. window 窗戶。
Not me. 我不會。I’d chase it out the window. 我一定要把牠從窗戶趕出去。
How? 怎麼趕?
I’ve got a broom.我有掃把。

3. outside 外面。
You want to hit the animal?! 你要打那隻動物?!
Well, I just want it to go outside. 我只要牠到外面去。

4. ground 地上。
What if it falls to the ground? 要是牠掉到地上怎麼辦?
Oh, you’re right. I think I’d call for help. 說得也是。我想還是求救吧。

vocabulary.postscript:
請跟我一起讀今天的單字。
run跑 window窗戶 outside外面 ground地上

quiz.question: 1. Where is the university?
2. How many monkeys were there?
3. Why did all the monkeys race down the building?
options: a. They wanted to get the food on the ground.
b. They wanted to look cool.
c. They wanted to scare students.

title: Girl Fixes Stuffed Animals to Help Kids

content.en: In the U.S., a 12-year-old girl and her mom save old stuffed animals. They save them from being thrown away. These stuffed animals do not look good. But they looked good before. The girl and her mom wash the stuffed animals. Then they fix them. They make them look good again!
content.tw: 你會洗你舊的填充玩偶嗎？美國有一對母女不但收留舊的填充玩偶，還會把他們清洗乾淨。

content.en: This year, the girl learned something sad. Families can lose everything in fires and other disasters. They can lose their homes. They can lose money and other important things. And kids can lose all their toys! So now the girl helps kids. Some of the kids lost toys in fires. Some lost toys in earthquakes, floods, or typhoons. These kids get the stuffed animals she fixed. They help the kids feel better.
content.tw: 這名12歲的女孩想要安慰在災害中失去一切的孩子，於是把整理好的玩偶送給他們，讓玩偶陪伴他們。

content.en: The girl gave 114 stuffed animals to kids this year. Wow! And she and her mom are fixing more to give to kids. This girl was shy about sharing her story. But now she is sharing it. She hopes kids will hear her story and try to help people too!
content.tw: 這個小女孩今年送出了114隻填充玩偶，她希望把消息傳出去，讓更多人也來幫忙！你會怎麼幫助其他人呢？

content.en: Will you help?
content.tw: 你願意幫忙嗎？

vocabulary.preface: 舊的動物玩偶經常沒用了，整理好之後卻可以分享給小朋友。

content.text:
1. family 家人，家庭。
Are all these toys yours? 這些玩具全部是你的?
Sure, they are gifts from family and friends. 當然，是家人跟朋友給我的禮物。

2. throw away 扔掉。
And you’ve kept them for years. 你多年來就一直保留著。
Yeah, I don’t want to throw any of them away. 對，我一個都不想扔掉。

3. feel 感覺。
You have enough stuffed animals to open a store! 你的玩偶多到可以開玩具店了。
Isn’t it great? I feel safe with them around. 可不是很棒? 有他們在我覺得很安全。

4. fix 修理。
But your teddy bear is missing an ear. 但是你的泰迪熊一隻耳朵沒了。
Oh, I want to fix it, but I don’t know how to sew. 我要修它的，但是我不會縫紉。
